title: Haldi as celestial intelligence rather than ancient aliens

tellings.quote: has been a bit skewed from what I look at with these Gods like haldi it seems more like some kind of celestial intelligence

plain: The idea is that Haldi, a god worshipped long ago around Lake Van in eastern Turkey, was not a visiting alien, as the "ancient aliens" view of old gods would have it, but some kind of intelligence from the heavens. A researcher named Matt LaCroix offers this as his own reading on the show, without naming a source, saying the usual view "has been a bit skewed" and Haldi "seems more like some kind of celestial intelligence."
